name: European June heatwave
headline: Persistent high with southerly flow from North Africa.

sections.The setup: Near-record-dry soils after record May heat.
sections.The trigger: Persistent high with southerly flow from North Africa.
sections.Climate signal: 3.5 °C hotter by day than the same pattern in 1976 (WWA).
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
